g.text: Runpod: native trace and source-coordinate root finding
Source c0176f942 · 8 vCPU / 16 GB · one pinned measurement CPU · shared host, no L2
Root panel: five rounds, 32 full calls per row; literal datum supplied and validated each call.
Isogeny arms additionally construct and validate the full toy codomain datum. FLINT uses no datum.
Translation panel: five rounds on each of two fields; collisions and exceptional handling included.
The frozen point-support audit is recorded separately from the translation timer.
Unsigned descriptive measurements. No fitted exponent, fastest-tool claim or security-tier promotion.
